tasks.label: opencode: install dependencies
tasks.command: [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); chcp 65001 > $null; if ($env:BUN_LINKS_PATH -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $env:BUN_LINKS_PATH)) { $env:Path = $env:BUN_LINKS_PATH + ';' + $env:Path }; $winGetLinks = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Microsoft\WinGet\Links'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $winGetLinks) { $env:Path = $winGetLinks + ';' + $env:Path }; if (Get-Command 'nvm' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { nvm use 24.11.1 }; bun install
